name: SangoSimMod
description: Sango (sango_infinity) simulation kernel port: framework core subset, hex math, game objects, custom JSON converters, and the scenario/system/action closure they need to compile. SangoRuntime boots the world from SangoContentMod assets via VFS (seeded GameRandom, deferred reference binding) and bridges Ludots Manual clock TurnAdvanced to sango turn advancement.
